around.headline: Gym trainer killed after assault at gym anniversary party; four held
around.summary: The Hindu, Deccan Herald and TOI report a 25-year-old gym trainer died after a quarrel between trainers and a customer turned violent, with four detained. If a party argument starts heating up, leave early and call 112 rather than stepping in.

around.headline: Heavy rain floods key Bengaluru roads; one commuter takes 3 hours for 19 km
around.summary: The Times of India reports waterlogging on key roads, and NDTV and Hindustan Times cover a woman's 19 km, 3-hour peak-hour ordeal. Check live traffic before leaving and avoid underpasses holding water.

around.headline: Race Course Road: 60-day traffic curbs from Oct 5
around.summary: Deccan Herald and TOI report part of Race Course Road is restricted with diversions for 60 days. Plan an alternate route, especially on wet evenings.
around.source: Deccan Herald, The Times of India

around.headline: Techie drowns in abandoned quarry during Instagram-group trek
around.summary: TOI and India Today report the techie drowned in a stone quarry near Bengaluru while trekking, and the body was found after a two-day search. Skip swimming in quarries and vet who is organising a group trek.
around.source: The Times of India, India Today

around.headline: Parking to open at 12 Metro stations; Pink Line underground trial run before 2026 ends
around.summary: Public TV reports parking facilities will open at 12 Metro stations soon, and Deccan Herald says Pink Line underground systems work is nearly complete. A trial run is not passenger service yet.

around.headline: Private land handed over for road widening to ease Nallurhalli traffic
around.summary: TOI reports citizens have given private land for road widening, which should ease traffic at Nallurhalli. Residents nearby may see works begin.

around.headline: Second Vande Bharat sleeper to link Bengaluru and Mumbai this month
around.summary: TOI and NDTV report the second Vande Bharat sleeper will connect Bengaluru and Mumbai, cutting travel time. Watch for booking announcements if you travel that route.

street_smart.title: At a friend's party, an argument between two guests turns loud. One shoves the other, voices rise, and a few people start pulling out phones or picking sides. What do you do?
street_smart.based_on: The Hindu / Deccan Herald / TOI, Oct 5: gym trainer killed after a quarrel at a gym anniversary party; four held.
street_smart.situation: You know both people slightly. The music is loud, drinks have been flowing, and the host is nowhere in sight. The shoving has already started.

choices.text: Step between them and physically hold one of them back.
choices.feedback: Putting your body in a drunk, escalating fight makes you a target and can turn a shoving match into a group brawl. Crowds amplify anger because each person fears losing face.

choices.text: Move people away, get the host or a sober friend, and call 112 if anyone is hurt or weapons appear.
choices.feedback: Distance and time cool a fight. Bringing in the host or a respected friend gives the angry person a face-saving way out, and 112 gets help without you taking the risk.

choices.text: Film it on your phone so there is evidence.
choices.feedback: Filming adds an audience, which fuels escalation, and does nothing to stop injury. Call for help first.

choices.text: Pick the side of the friend you know better and shout at the other.
choices.feedback: Taking sides turns a two-person fight into a group fight and can make you a participant.

takeaways: Call 112 early if anyone is hurt or a weapon appears; give the address and stay on the line.
Don't physically intervene in an escalating fight; create distance and bring a calm third person.
If you are hurt or in a fight yourself, leave first and report later.

quiz.question: For how many days are traffic curbs on part of Race Course Road in force from Oct 5?
quiz.why: Diversions run for 60 days. Race Course Road runs beside the Bangalore Turf Club grounds in the central city.

quiz.question: When does the 10-day Bengaluru Jatre cultural festival begin?
quiz.why: It runs Dec 4 to 13 across streets and parks. Jatre is the Kannada word for a fair or festival.

quiz.question: The Nobel medicine prize announced this week honours work on using what to study the brain?
quiz.why: Reuters reports German and US scientists won for work on light and the brain. Light-based methods can switch specific nerve cells on or off.

quiz.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution guarantees the right to life and personal liberty?
quiz.why: Article 21 has been read broadly by courts to include clean environment, privacy and speedy trial. Article 32 is the right to move the Supreme Court.

quiz.question: Which of these states is NOT crossed by the Tropic of Cancer?
quiz.why: The Tropic of Cancer crosses eight states, from Gujarat to Mizoram. Karnataka lies well south of it, in the tropics.
